question: What is the rated power of Press P2 in kW?
What is the cycle time of Washer W1 in seconds?
What is the mean time to repair (MTTR) of Inspection station I1 in hours?
What is the capacity of buffer B3 in parts?
Which machine does buffer B4 feed?
On which machine did incident INC-207 happen?
What was the failure mode of incident INC-203?
At what hour of the day does the Night shift start?
Which incident was repaired by work order WO-1104?
Which machine is the last station of Line A?
Which machine downstream of the bottleneck machine (the machine with the longest cycle time) has the highest rated power?
sparql: SELECT ?v WHERE { { SELECT ?b WHERE { ?b mfg:cycleTimeS ?c } ORDER BY DESC(?c) LIMIT 1 } ?b mfg:feeds+ ?v . ?v a mfg:Machine ; mfg:powerKW ?p } ORDER BY DESC(?p) LIMIT 1

question: Which machine feeds the buffer that feeds Washer W1?
sparql: SELECT ?v WHERE { ?v a mfg:Machine ; mfg:feeds ?b . ?b mfg:feeds ex:machine_W1 }

question: What is the rated power, in kW, of the machine that buffer B1 feeds?
On which machine did the failure that was repaired by work order WO-1103 happen?
What is the capacity, in parts, of the buffer directly upstream of Assembly cell A1?
sparql: SELECT ?v WHERE { ?b a mfg:Buffer ; mfg:feeds ex:machine_A1 ; mfg:capacity ?v }

question: During which shift did the failure that was repaired by work order WO-1108 happen?
What is the MTTR, in hours, of the machine on which incident INC-204 happened?
What is the cycle time, in seconds, of the machine that feeds the buffer in front of Packer K1?
sparql: SELECT ?v WHERE { ?b mfg:feeds ex:machine_K1 . ?m mfg:feeds ?b ; mfg:cycleTimeS ?v }

question: Which machine is the bottleneck of Line A, i.e. has the longest cycle time?
sparql: SELECT ?v WHERE { ?v mfg:cycleTimeS ?c } ORDER BY DESC(?c) LIMIT 1

question: How many failures happened during the Night shift?
sparql: SELECT (COUNT(?f) AS ?v) WHERE { ?f a mfg:Failure ; mfg:duringShift ex:shift_NIGHT }

question: What is the total production downtime, in hours, caused by failures of Press P2?
sparql: SELECT (SUM(?d) AS ?v) WHERE { ?f a mfg:Failure ; mfg:onMachine ex:machine_P2 ; mfg:downtimeH ?d }

question: Which machine had the most failures?
sparql: SELECT ?v WHERE { ?f a mfg:Failure ; mfg:onMachine ?v } GROUP BY ?v ORDER BY DESC(COUNT(?f)) LIMIT 1

question: How many preventive maintenance actions were carried out?
sparql: SELECT (COUNT(?a) AS ?v) WHERE { ?a a mfg:MaintenanceAction ; mfg:actionType "Preventive" }

question: What is the total rated power, in kW, of all machines on Line A?
sparql: SELECT (SUM(?p) AS ?v) WHERE { ?m a mfg:Machine ; mfg:powerKW ?p }

question: What is the total production downtime, in hours, of all failures?
sparql: SELECT (SUM(?d) AS ?v) WHERE { ?f a mfg:Failure ; mfg:downtimeH ?d }
